MUSIC AND DANCE — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MUSIC AND DANCE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. Only the costume
   C. The speed of the music
   D. The ticket price

2. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   B. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.

3. Best practice when working on Setting Text to Music: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Setting Text to Music.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Setting Text to Music.
   C. Damage equipment used for Setting Text to Music.
   D. Practise Setting Text to Music with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Red, blue, and yellow
   D. Black, white, and grey

5. Best practice when working on Western Style Solo Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Western Style Solo Songs.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Western Style Solo Songs.
   C. Damage equipment used for Western Style Solo Songs.
   D. Practise Western Style Solo Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. Best practice when working on Melody in Major Keys: (1 mark)

   C. Refuse all feedback on Melody in Major Keys.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Melody in Major Keys.

7. Best practice when working on Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;.
   B. Damage equipment used for Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;.
   D. Practise Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines; with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Songs.
   B. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Songs.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Songs.
   D. Practise Kenyan Folk Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem.
   C. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem.
   D. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins.

11. Best practice when working on Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song.
   C. Practise Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song.

12. Best practice when working on Music Notation Software: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Music Notation Software.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Music Notation Software.

13. Best practice when working on Dance Production: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Dance Production.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Dance Production.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Dance Production.
   D. Practise Dance Production with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

14. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Replace drinking water

15. Best practice when working on Transposition: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Transposition.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Transposition.
   C. Damage equipment used for Transposition.
   D. Practise Transposition with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Contemporary Dances-Kenyan 3.0 Critical Appreciation 3.1 Kenyan Folk Songs 3.2 C and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
